hero.title: Your Reliable Roofer, Metalworker and Glazier in Saalfelden
hero.description: Welcome to Karl Mayr GmbH & Co. KG – your reliable partner for roofing, facades and glass in Saalfelden. We stand for high-quality craftsmanship, precise execution and honest consultation. As a master craftsman workshop, we combine modern technology with traditional craftsmanship – for durable, safe and visually appealing solutions for your roof.
hero.subtitle: Our service areas extend far beyond Saalfelden: We serve our customers throughout the Pinzgau region, in Tyrol, the city of Salzburg and in Upper Bavaria. Whether private residential, commercial or renovation projects – wherever quality is required, we are your reliable contact.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Roofing, Metalwork and Glazing in Saalfelden

roofing.title: Roofing
roofing.shortDescription: Masterful handcraft for durable roofs. We plan, cover and renovate roofs with high-quality materials – precise, safe and visually convincing.
roofing.heroTitle: Roofing in Saalfelden – Quality from Master Craftsmen
roofing.heroDescription: A solid roof is the foundation for protection, safety and living comfort. We are your reliable roofer in Saalfelden – with masterful craftsmanship and years of experience. Whether pitched roof, flat roof or renovation – we offer well-thought-out solutions that perfectly combine function and design.
roofing.sectionText:
As a master roofing workshop, we place the greatest emphasis on professional planning and execution. Each roof is individually tailored to the building's requirements and covered with high-quality materials. We rely on modern techniques and proven craftsmanship – for a result that lasts for decades.

Our services include new roofing, roof renovations, thermal insulation, roof window installation and storm damage repairs. Whether tile, slate or metal roofing – we create durable solutions that combine weather resistance, energy efficiency and attractive appearance.

With a well-coordinated team of qualified specialists, we ensure that every detail is right – from the substructure to the last row of roof tiles.

metalwork.title: Metalwork
metalwork.shortDescription: From gutters to chimney caps to window sills – we manufacture and install metalwork from copper, aluminum, stainless steel or zinc with precision and weather resistance.
metalwork.heroTitle: Metalwork in Saalfelden – Precision from Master Hands
metalwork.heroDescription: Metalwork reveals how much detailed work goes into a perfectly executed roof. We manufacture and install all metalwork around the roof – precisely fitting, weatherproof and visually harmonious.
metalwork.sectionText:
From installing gutters and chimney caps to attic flashings to window sills – we carry out all metalwork professionally and precisely. We process high-quality materials such as copper, aluminum, stainless steel or zinc that guarantee durability and weather resistance.

Thanks to modern manufacturing techniques and craftsmanship, individual solutions are created that perfectly match the overall appearance of the building. As an experienced metalwork workshop in Saalfelden, we place particular emphasis on clean processing, exact fits and stable fastenings – for functionality, quality and an appealing appearance that lasts.

glazing.title: Glazing
glazing.shortDescription: Whether repair, full-glass installation or shower glazing – we offer clear glass solutions that perfectly combine design and function.
glazing.heroTitle: Glazing in Saalfelden – Clear Solutions with Style
glazing.heroDescription: Glass combines transparency, light and design. As an experienced glazing workshop in Saalfelden, we offer high-quality glass work for interiors and exteriors – from classic to modern.
glazing.sectionTitle: Custom Glass Elements for Every Application
glazing.sectionText: Whether new glazing, repair or custom fabrication – we offer a wide range of glazing work. This includes full-glass systems, glass doors, partitions, shower glazing, kitchen backsplashes, leaded glass and sandblast designs. We are also quickly on site for glass breakage and storm damage.

facade.title: Facade
facade.shortDescription: Facades in metal, wood-look or fiber cement – modern, durable and energy-efficient. Ideal for new builds and renovations.
facade.heroTitle: Facades – Protection, Design and Function in Perfection
facade.heroDescription: The facade is the calling card of your building – and crucial for weather protection, energy efficiency and visual impact.
facade.sectionTitle: Facade Work with System and Style
facade.sectionText: We offer metal facades, wood-look facades and fiber cement facades for new construction and renovation – including integrated thermal insulation and fire protection elements.

sealing.title: Sealing Work
sealing.shortDescription: Sealing with bitumen or plastic – reliable, tight and durable. Perfect for flat roofs, terraces and garages.
sealing.heroTitle: Sealing Work – Reliable Protection for Every Structure
sealing.heroDescription: Professional sealing is essential to permanently protect buildings from moisture and weather influences. We offer sealing solutions for roofs, terraces, balconies and more – safe, durable and precisely executed.
sealing.sectionTitle: Flat Roof and Building Sealing from Specialists
sealing.sectionText:
We work with high-quality bitumen membranes and modern plastic films that withstand even extreme weather conditions. Whether new construction, renovation or repair – we ensure tight and permanent solutions that optimally insulate and minimize energy losses.

Our specialists reliably carry out sealing work on flat roofs, garages, terraces or bridges – with particular attention to detail work and durable connections.

Through professional execution and combination with thermal insulation, systems are created that are both functionally and economically convincing.

greenRoofs.title: Green Roofs
greenRoofs.shortDescription: With a green roof, you create additional living space, improve the indoor climate and protect your roof sealing at the same time.
greenRoofs.heroTitle: Green Roofs – Sustainable Roofing Solutions from Master Craftsmen
greenRoofs.heroDescription: A green roof is more than just an architectural highlight – it's a piece of nature on your building.
greenRoofs.sectionTitle: Roof Greening – Ecological, Durable and Functional
greenRoofs.sectionText: Through additional greening, rainwater is stored, ambient temperature is regulated and sound protection is improved. We offer both extensive greening with sedum plants and intensive systems for walkable garden areas. We combine craftsmanship with state-of-the-art technology.

about.title: About Us
about.heroTitle: Your Master Workshop for Roofing, Facades and Glass in Saalfelden
about.heroDescription: Our company stands on a solid foundation of craftsmanship. We combine decades of experience with modern technology and the highest master-level quality.
about.experienceTitle: Experience and Expertise that Builds Trust
about.experienceText: Founded in 1972, we operate as a family business in its second generation. All work – whether roofing, facades or glass – is planned and executed by trained specialists. We place great value on precise work, high-quality materials and professional implementation down to the smallest detail. This combination of knowledge, experience and passion for the craft makes the difference – and ensures that our customers receive durable results they can rely on.
about.teamDescription: Every successful project depends on well-trained specialists with experience and technical expertise.
